say:1:1524607001:0.text: Why haven't the hunters come back yet? It's getting late...
say:1:1524607001:0.source_cn: 已经这么晚了，狩猎队为什么还没有返回……
say:1:1524607001:0.male: Why haven't the hunters come back yet? It's getting late...
say:1:1524607001:0.female: Why haven't the hunters come back yet? It's getting late...

say:2:1524607002:1.text: Did they run into some beasts again...
say:2:1524607002:1.source_cn: 难道，丛林里的野兽又引发了意外吗……
say:2:1524607002:1.male: Did they run into some beasts again...
say:2:1524607002:1.female: Did they run into some beasts again...

say:3:1524607003:1.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm worried about the hunters. Could you help me <style="highlight">check on them</style>?

say:0:1524608001:0.text: These footprints lead deeper into the forest. They are probably the hunters', so I'll go after them.
say:0:1524608001:0.source_cn: 这些通向森林深处的脚印应该是狩猎队留下的，跟上去看看吧。

say:0:1524608001:0.female: These footprints lead deeper into the forest. They are probably the hunters', so I'll go after them.

say:1:1524610001:0.text: Finally, someone's here! That gentleman over there! Please go back and get help!
say:1:1524610001:0.source_cn: 总算看见人了！你……你，快回营地求援！
say:1:1524610001:0.male: Finally, someone's here! That gentleman over there! Please go back and get help!
say:1:1524610001:0.female: Finally, someone's here! That lady over there! Please go back and get help!

say:3:1524610002:1.text: We were chasing a beast and didn't realize how far we'd gone! Before we knew it, a pack of them had us surrounded!
say:3:1524610002:1.source_cn: 我们追着一只野兽，没注意跑到了森林深处，被一群野兽围攻了。
say:3:1524610002:1.male: We were chasing a beast and didn't realize how far we'd gone! Before we knew it, a pack of them had us surrounded!
say:3:1524610002:1.female: We were chasing a beast and didn't realize how far we'd gone! Before we knew it, a pack of them had us surrounded!

say:4:1524610003:1.text: I'm the only one who made it out. Thank heavens you're here! I'll join the rest and try to hold the beasts off!
say:4:1524610003:1.source_cn: 狩猎队脱不出身，只有我跑了出来。你快回营地求援，我回去...
say:4:1524610003:1.male: I'm the only one who made it out. Thank heavens you're here! I'll join the rest and try to hold the beasts off!

choice_prompt:5:1524610003.text: I'm the only one who made it out. Thank heavens you're here! I'll join the rest and try to hold the beasts off!
choice_prompt:5:1524610003.source_cn: 狩猎队脱不出身，只有我跑了出来。你快回营地求援，我回去继续战斗，能拖多久是多久！
choice_prompt:5:1524610003.male: I'm the only one who made it out. Thank heavens you're here! I'll join the rest and try to hold the beasts off!

say:6:1524610004:1.source_cn: 你……等等，原来是你，那个魔法师！

choice:5:0:1.text: No need to return to the camp!
choice:5:0:1.male: No need to return to the camp!
choice:5:0:1.female: No need to return to the camp!

say:3:1524615001:0.text: Can't believe I actually made it...
say:3:1524615001:0.source_cn: 活下来了，我还以为要死了……

say:4:1524615002:0.text: A-Are you even human? You took down that entire pack without breaking a sweat! We have a big haul today!
say:4:1524615002:0.source_cn: 你，你好强啊！一下就把那群野兽全都打倒了，今天是大丰收！
say:4:1524615002:0.male: A-Are you even human? You took down that entire pack without breaking a sweat! We have a big haul today!
say:4:1524615002:0.female: A-Are you even human? You took down that entire pack without breaking a sweat! We have a big haul today!

say:5:1524615003:0.text: Do you really think we should be celebrating? We only got lucky that the mage showed up!
say:5:1524615003:0.source_cn: 什么大丰收，你还高兴上了！今天要不是我们运气好，恰巧碰...
say:5:1524615003:0.male: Do you really think we should be celebrating? We only got lucky that the mage showed up!
say:5:1524615003:0.female: Do you really think we should be celebrating? We only got lucky that the mage showed up!

say:8:1524615005:1.text: Thank you for saving our lives. It was our misjudgment and greed that got us into trouble today.
say:8:1524615005:1.source_cn: 谢谢你出手相助，救下了我们一命。今天是我们判断失误，太...
say:8:1524615005:1.male: Thank you for saving our lives. It was our misjudgment and greed that got us into trouble today.
say:8:1524615005:1.female: Thank you for saving our lives. It was our misjudgment and greed that got us into trouble today.

say:9:1524615006:1.text: We'll take this as a lesson and be more careful in the future.
say:9:1524615006:1.source_cn: 我们会引以为戒，以后狩猎时一定更加谨慎。
say:9:1524615006:1.male: We'll take this as a lesson and be more careful in the future.
say:9:1524615006:1.female: We'll take this as a lesson and be more careful in the future.

say:10:1524615007:1.text: Time to bring the game back now. Thanks again.
say:10:1524615007:1.source_cn: 那我们先带着猎物回去了。再次感谢你。谢谢。
say:10:1524615007:1.male: Time to bring the game back now. Thanks again.
say:10:1524615007:1.female: Time to bring the game back now. Thanks again.

say:2:1524616002:1.text: I heard what took place in the forest. Good thing you helped the hunters, or the aid station would've been overwhelmed again.

say:2:1524616002:1.female: I heard what took place in the forest. Good thing you helped the hunters, or the aid station would've been overwhelmed again.
